moments.text: Blue-tinted camera view of sky with clouds streaking past; a dark red rounded object drifts from upper left to below the crosshair.
The view zooms in: the object, now large and pink-red with a darker lower side, rises past the crosshair and leaves the top right edge.
Zoomed back out, the object sits at the top right edge, then leaves; glimpsed at the right edge near 17 s and 20-22 s.
The object re-enters from the right and drifts to upper left of the crosshair as clouds stream past.
Zoomed in again: the large pink object, a dark part hanging below, rides the top edge, then slips out of the top.
It drops back in at the top, drifts down onto the crosshair around 41 s, then rises to the right and leaves the right edge.
A pale pink rounded shape shows briefly at the top right corner before leaving the top.
A dark frame, a pale flash, then a wider view: cloud streaks race past and the object is a small pink dot near the top.
The picture goes soft: the object shows as a hollow ring drifting from the top to upper left, then sharpens back into a pink dot.
The small pink dot wanders upper left and left of the crosshair while cloud patches slide past.
After dark frames the view zooms in: the pink object drifts from upper left to just left of the crosshair, then lower left.
